name: A dark black hole in fomalhaut's heart
source:
In Sitedelle's nightclub, flooded with blinding music and booming lights, Memphis – a self-proclaimed "player" – is on the lookout for a one-night stand. 

However, they soon realize that the single women in the area might be less ideal – or perhaps better – than what they had in mind.

[From [url=https://luckyfunfun.itch.io/a-dark-black-hole]Itch.io[/url]]
